title: Mountains worldwide as possible alien bases
place_text: Mount Zeil, Mount Hayes, Mount Perdido, Mount Shasta

tellings.quote: world. You have Mount Zeil and uh you know, you have Mount you know, that's in Australia. You have Mount Hayes in Alaska.

plain: Some mountains around the world, Mount Zeil in Australia, Mount Hayes in Alaska, Mount Perdido and Mount Shasta, are floated as possible hidden bases for non-human visitors. Michels lists them himself, without naming a source, in a conversation with the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property whose owners report strange happenings there. If true, it would mean such visitors keep stations on Earth rather than only passing through.
